caption:
What if gratitude changed how you treated people today?

Qur'an 14:7 ties gratitude to increase.

One action today: thank someone specifically for something they did.

Share it with a friend.

📖 Sources
• Qur'an 14:7 (tr. Saheeh International) — quran.com/14/7
• Recitation: Qur'an 14:7 — Mahmoud Khalil Al-Husary (EveryAyah.com) — quran.com/14/7

#IslamicReminder #DailyDeen #Shukr #Quran
